name: cookbook
description: Self-hosted family recipe app. Public portfolio repo; recipes stay on the NAS.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cookbook/shared build && pnpm --filter @cookbook/api build && pnpm --filter @cookbook/mcp build && pnpm --filter @cookbook/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @cookbook/shared build && pnpm --filter @cookbook/shared lint && pnpm --filter @cookbook/api lint && pnpm --filter @cookbook/mcp lint && pnpm --filter @cookbook/web lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @cookbook/shared build && pnpm --filter @cookbook/shared test && pnpm --filter @cookbook/api test && pnpm --filter @cookbook/mcp test
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm secrets && pnpm audit --audit-level=high && pnpm requirements
